brand.name: Lumen
brand.product: Lumen vitamin C 15% serum, 30 ml amber dropper bottle

brief.audience: Women 28-45 in Mexico City with dull skin after bad sleep
brief.angle: Tired skin in the morning mirror, glow by breakfast

style.look: clean beauty commercial realism, soft diffusion, natural skin texture with visible pores
style.audio_bed: a soft acoustic guitar loop at low volume

characters.name: The woman
characters.identity: woman in her late thirties, warm medium-brown skin, black curly hair pulled into a loose bun, small silver stud earrings, white cotton robe

shots.subject: The woman at a bathroom mirror at 7am
shots.action: leans in close, presses two fingertips under one eye and frowns at her reflection
shots.setting: small tiled bathroom, fogged edges on the mirror

details.environment: flat cold light from a frosted window
details.micro_action: she tugs the skin under her eye and lets it go
details.motif: a dripping tap ticks once per second

shots.camera: static close-up over her shoulder into the mirror
shots.light: cool, flat morning light, slightly underexposed

shots.subject: A hand
shots.action: lifts the amber Lumen dropper bottle off the stone shelf and squeezes the bulb
shots.setting: the same bathroom shelf, cream backdrop

details.environment: warm sunlight begins to break through the window
details.micro_action: a single golden drop forms at the pipette tip
details.motif: the glass pipette clinks against the bottle neck

shots.audio: soft glass clink, the guitar loop starts
shots.final_image: the golden drop hanging from the pipette

image_refs.label: the product bottle, for its amber color and label

shots.subject: A golden serum drop
shots.action: lands on a fingertip and spreads into a thin glossy film as the finger presses onto a cheek
shots.setting: extreme close-up of skin with visible pores

details.environment: sunlight rakes across the skin texture
details.micro_action: the fingertip rolls in a small circle
details.motif: the amber of the serum matches the bottle

shots.audio: a faint soft tap of the fingertip
shots.final_image: the cheek with a dewy sheen

shots.subject: The amber Lumen bottle on the stone shelf
shots.action: stays still while a slow band of sunlight sweeps across the label and back
shots.setting: cream backdrop, nothing else on the shelf

details.environment: fine dust glows in the sunbeam
details.micro_action: the serum inside the glass catches the light and glows
details.motif: the sunlight band crosses the logo once

shots.light: soft top light with a warm rim
shots.audio: the guitar loop resolves on one chord
shots.final_image: the bottle facing camera, label fully readable
